string.text: Weaver mount, type 1
Intended for installation of tactical flashlights and laser sights. Scopes and foregrips cannot be installed due to the structure of the mount.
Laser sight

Provides a visual point of reference, visually marks the expected point of impact, facilitates and speeds up aiming, and has a demoralizing effect on the enemy. Does not interfere with the tactical flashlight and can be installed along with it.
Tactical flashlight
Long-range narrow beam flashlight is essential for night raids, as well as to seach and clear poorly lit rooms. Does not interfere with the laser sight and can be installed along with it.
Weaver mount, type 2
Enables installation of tactical foregrips and various sights. Laser sights and tactical flashlights cannot be installed due to the structure of the mount.
Tactical foregrip
Improves handling, therefore facilitates recoil management.
Lightweight magazine
maintenance polymer magazine reduces overall weight of the firearm.
Heat dissipation
Improved mechanism of heat dissipation in the integrated suppressor significantly increases durability.
Trigger calibration
Individual adjustment and balancing of the standard parts of the trigger mechanism improve accuracy, while simultaneously lowering recoil.
Trigger tuning
Increases rate of fire at the cost of wear-resistance.
Protective coating
Application of a protective coating to the barrel and the critical parts of the firearm improves its durability.
Recoil pad
Recoil pad from GP-25 accessories' kit dampens felt recoil.
Tritium sights
Tritium-illuminated sights increase speed and comfort of aiming in poorly-lit environments.
Rebored barrel
Faster twist rate increases muzzle velocity and reduces bullet dispersion.
